author: NNNNNr
description:
OneVTok sixteen-register models — 2026-11-22
	

Public code and weight release. Original private archive remains private.
Current release phase: Exact EMA inference weights first. Files are listed as available only after HF size and SHA256 verification.

	
		
	
	
		Exact FP32 EMA inference weights
	

These files contain the original EMA tensors without precision conversion. They exclude Adam, RAW copies and RNG training state. Recovered tensor shapes/dtypes/values were checked… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/NNNNNr/onevtok-reg16-models-20261122.
